legend  PROXY = route observer applies today (or dash). SURFACE = the
        surface-specific routability bucket (routable / after-upstream /
        after-bridge / probe / native-exempt). TOKEN shows the capture
        tier, with (gap) flagging a known hole. VOCAB = the adapter's
        native tool names are carried by the canonical taxonomy
        (internal/tooltax), so its tool calls resolve to canonical
        action types; a dash means the capture has no native tool
        vocabulary at all (`observer doctor <tool>` prints the grounded
        reason). HANDOFF shows the session-handoff transcript tier +
        launch mode (seeded / doc-assisted); a dash is the
        actions-only carry floor (file lane only, not launchable in
        the embedded terminal). ATTACH = can hand the PTY to the
        daemon for dashboard jump-in (`observer <x> --attach`).
        RESUME = how a closed session reopens: native (the tool's own
        resume) / handoff (a --continue-from fork) / dash (neither).
        ENFORCE = the guard-policy enforcement bucket (P7): hook-block
        (a wired tool-gate hook, its deny proven live, can deny the call) /
        sandbox (no blocking hook, but the launcher can require a bwrap
        sandboxed launch - Linux/WSL2 only; this is the STATIC bucket,
        not degraded for the current host) / org-disallow (neither hook
        nor sandbox - a signed org policy naming the tool disallowed is
        the only lever) / recorded (no grounded lever at all - an
        acknowledgment, not a block).
        LIFECYCLE = the vendor-support status under the harness
        lifecycle policy: active (advertised for install / launch /
        init) vs DEPRECATED / DEAD (never advertised - but ALWAYS
        still captured; rows are never deleted). `observer doctor
        <tool>` prints the grounded reason verbatim. PROMPT = the
        prompt-submit intervention lane (docs/guard-prompt.md):
        hook (a verified, wired dialect) / proxy-only (no hook, the
        proxy lane is the only path) / probe (a documented mechanism
        whose exact wire shape is unverified - `observer doctor
        --probe-hook <tool>` decides) / dash (no grounded capability).

product lifecycle (products with no adapter row of their own):
ID                              STATUS      SERVICED-BY  NOTE
gemini-code-assist-individuals  DEPRECATED  gemini-cli   On 2026-06-18 Google stopped serving Gemini CLI and the Gemini
                                                         Code Assist IDE extensions for the free 'for individuals' tier
                                                         and for Google AI Pro / Ultra accounts; those users are directed
                                                         to the Antigravity family (Antigravity CLI `agy` and the
                                                         Antigravity IDE - Observer rows antigravity-cli / antigravity).
                                                         Gemini Code Assist STANDARD and ENTERPRISE subscriptions are
                                                         unchanged, so the gemini-cli registry row stays ACTIVE (capture,
                                                         install and launch still valid for those tiers); the operator's
                                                         live attempt 2026-09-03 returned "This client is no longer
                                                         supported for Gemini Code Assist for individuals". Sources:
                                                         https://developers.google.com/gemini-code-assist/docs/deprecations/code-assist-individuals,
                                                         https://developers.googleblog.com/an-important-update-transitioning-gemini-cli-to-antigravity-cli/.
open-interpreter-python         DEAD        —            The legacy Python open-interpreter line (pip `open-interpreter`)
                                                         is no longer vendor-maintained as of 2026 and lives on only as
                                                         the community fork endolith/open-interpreter; the vendor's
                                                         current product is the Rust rewrite based on Codex that the
                                                         `open-interpreter` registry row targets. COMMAND-NAME COLLISION:
                                                         both answer to `interpreter`. Observer's adapter is path-keyed
                                                         (~/.openinterpreter/sessions via INTERPRETER_HOME, a codex
                                                         retag) and never reads the Python line's data; any launcher or
                                                         detector keyed on the command name must disambiguate by binary
                                                         path / version string. Sources:
                                                         https://pypi.org/project/open-interpreter,
                                                         https://github.com/endolith/open-interpreter,
                                                         docs/audits/vendor-surface-inventory-2026-09-03.md §3.3.
roo-code                        DEAD        cline        Roo Code (RooVeterinaryInc.roo-cline) shut down 2026-04-21; the
                                                         GitHub repo and the VS Code extension were archived read-only
                                                         2026-05-15 at v3.54.0 and the vendor pivoted to the Slack-only
                                                         cloud product Roomote (community continuation: ZooCode).
                                                         Observer keeps parsing the existing
                                                         rooveterinaryinc.roo-cline/tasks globalStorage through
                                                         internal/adapter/cline (a per-file retag, no roo-code registry
                                                         row by design - IDE-20) and never deletes its rows; nothing is
                                                         advertised for it. Sources:
                                                         https://github.com/RooCodeInc/Roo-Code (archived),
                                                         docs/audits/vendor-surface-inventory-2026-09-03.md §3.3 (MEDIUM
                                                         confidence - third-party corroboration, Roo's own pages are
                                                         archived).
windsurf                        DEPRECATED  devin        Windsurf was renamed Devin Desktop on 2026-06-02 (Cognition
                                                         folded the Windsurf IDE and the Devin agent into one install).
                                                         The name survives as an ALIAS only: the IDE still installs under
                                                         %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Windsurf with a `windsurf` shim, and its
                                                         bundled devin.exe lane is expected to write ~/.devin (captured
                                                         by the devin row, UNVERIFIED until a logged-in run). The
                                                         separate Cascade / "Devin Local" agent store is NOT covered
                                                         (would be a new tool id - inventory §3.1 #2). Source:
                                                         https://docs.devin.ai/desktop,
                                                         docs/audits/vendor-surface-inventory-2026-09-03.md §1.5.
zoo-code                        active      cline        ZooCode (ZooCodeOrganization.zoo-code) is the community
                                                         continuation of Roo Code after its 2026-04-21 shutdown, shipped
                                                         2026 as a separate VS Code listing; parsed by
                                                         internal/adapter/cline as a per-file retag (no registry row by
                                                         design, like roo-code). Vendor status: active community project
                                                         - on-disk extension-dir spelling still UNCONFIRMED (inventory
                                                         rates the ext id LOW; the Marketplace id
                                                         ZooCodeOrganization.zoo-code itself is vendor-confirmed).
                                                         Sources: https://www.zoocode.dev/,
                                                         https://github.com/Zoo-Code-Org/Zoo-Code,
                                                         docs/audits/vendor-surface-inventory-2026-09-03.md §2.6 /
                                                         §3.3.
